# 1_52

<span class="tada-chip tada-chip--muted">complete</span> <span class="tada-chip tada-chip--muted" title="Locked flights are released from the window; trained and scored in that environment">release MDP</span> <span class="tada-chip tada-chip--warn" title="Trained and scored on the BGY point merge (use case 2), not the MXP trombone">point merge</span>

**What changed:** 1_50 fine-tuned on the BGY point merge (use case 2), release MDP as 1_50, stitched 2×20 point-merge streams from a pre-screened pool of feasible ones. LR 1e-4 to 1e-5, 100k critic warm-up, seed 52.

!!! note "Release MDP"
    This model trained in the release MDP, unlike the champion and every model before `1_49`: after each step the front of the landing queue is released once a flight is locked (predicted within 30 s of its target and in no predicted conflict). A released flight leaves the window and can no longer be cleared. It is scored in the same environment, on the same seeds and with the same metrics, so its numbers measure landings in the same scenarios, but under that extra constraint on the agent.

!!! warning "Point merge"
    Trained and scored on the BGY point merge (`VALIDATION_USE_CASE_2`), not the MXP trombone: every score on this card is a point-merge score, on the same 100 validation seeds. It is compared only with point-merge scores: its parent's and the MXP champion's zero-shot scores ([Point merge](../findings/point-merge.md)), or a point-merge parent's own.

!!! info "About this run"
    Trained after the bust clawback (code commit 618a073): a loss of separation takes back the release payments of flights still airborne. Its training pool excludes the validation candidates.

## Reproduce

```bash
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 TADA_MAX_PICKS=2 python -u main_jax.py --env windowed --reward-mode outcome_pbrs --stitch-segments 2 --stitch-gap 120 900 --hard-bracket --release-locked --pay-at-release --flat-deviation --train-seed-pool analysis/2026-09-28_pms/pool/train_k2_pms.txt --init-weights experiments/atc_run_1_50_scratch_d_release_s1/final_model.zip --n-envs 32 --critic-warmup-steps 100000 --lr-max 0.0001 --final-lr 1e-05 --ent-coef 0.01 --warmup-frac 0.08 --vf-coef 0.25 --target-kl 0.05 --total-timesteps 10000000

# score: 20-flight and stitched 2x20, 10 attempts, lookahead (100 validation seeds)
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 TADA_MAX_PICKS=2 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_52_pms_1_50/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --attempts 9
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 TADA_MAX_PICKS=2 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_52_pms_1_50/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --segments 2 --gap 120 900
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 TADA_MAX_PICKS=2 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_52_pms_1_50/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --lookahead 4
```
